description: This file defines a setup wizard for WhatsApp integration within a plugin-based system. It manages linking status, prompts, and finalization of WhatsApp account setup.

classes.name: ChannelSetupWizard
classes.description: Type/interface defining the structure for a setup wizard for a communication channel.

methods.name: resolveShouldPromptAccountIds
methods.description: Determines if the system should prompt for account IDs based on configuration.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the WhatsApp setup process, possibly involving user prompts and configuration updates.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the WhatsApp channel in the current configuration.

methods.name: onAccountRecorded
methods.description: Callback invoked when an account ID is recorded during setup, allowing additional processing.
